name: codex-background-studio
description: Xskin: an in-app background studio for images and original 4K MP4 on macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Change your background inside Codex on macOS
interface.longDescription: Open Xskin from the global sidebar to choose, preview, and apply local images or original MP4 video without opening a separate settings window. Adjust mask depth, pause or resume the saved background, and keep your existing four-language preferences. Requires macOS and local execution.
